title: Measles Is Officially Back in the United States. What Now?
summary: It may take years for the country to regain elimination status. In the meantime, communities will need to adopt numerous strategies to protect people.
caption: A patient with a measles rash in Texas last year. The number of cases in the United States this year has topped 5,400, more than double last year’s tally and the highest since 1991, nearly a decade before the country attained elimination status.
tags: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
